notes.title: [AshBall DevLog #1 There is a Spirit in the Menu – UI Update & Minor Fixes
notes.notes:
🔧 A Small Touch: The Menu Feels More Alive! 🔥

Hello there!



Lately, I've been working on Blender, UI animation, and post-processing in Unity.

I've slowly started integrating what I learn into AshBall.



In this update:


  The menu title now has a typewriter animation (with an actual typewriter sound while typing 🖋️🎹)
  The Leaderboard button is now animated with a small "fire" effect that fits the lava theme
  Some old UI elements were simplified for a cleaner and more balanced look
  Post-processing adjustments were made for better tone harmony in the background
  A rare synchronization bug related to ball sharing was fixed


These may be small, but they add soul.

AshBall is still alive, learning, and growing 🍂🔥



Thanks!

notes.title: Update Incoming – It’s Gonna Be Intense!
notes.notes:
While testing the game, I found a way to hold the ball in my hands for way too long... 

And let's say I fixed that up nicely. 😈 And trust me, it won't let you slip away from this bug.

This patch brings new pressure, more chaos, and a constantly rising tempo.

We’re still working to make AshBall even more fun, intense, and unpredictable than what you saw in the trailer.

Also — i currently looking for a passionate 2D artist to collaborate with me! 

If you love creating UI art or character designs and want to be part of something wild (and awesome), feel free to reach out: 8kyaoo@gmail.com

Let’s make cool stuff together. ⚡

If you're still up after this... I'm just getting started, yeeeeee!!!
